mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to a monetary policy tightening response from the Fed and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but FEDFUNDS does not rise by > 50bp in the next 3 months, or SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO drops by > 2% m-o-m but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts series HOUST rises by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST y-o-y change exceeds 10% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time, or 2-year rolling Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate UNRATE is below 4% and payroll employment PAYEMS is rising by more than 200,000 per month, it signals an overheating labor market that will drive inflation and lead to a hawkish Fed response, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS m-o-m change > 200k, but FEDFUNDS does not rise by > 50bp in the next 3 months, or SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP GDPC1 is in a y-o-y decelerating trend for 2 consecutive quarters, it signals a slowing economy that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 y-o-y growth decelerates for 2+ consecutive quarters but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index CPIAUCSL is rising by more than 3% year-over-year and the federal funds rate FEDFUNDS is below 2%, it signals an inflationary environment that the Fed is behind the curve on, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in a hawkish policy response.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL y-o-y > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2%, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time, or the Fed does not deliver a 50bp hike within 3 months.
